description_en: Queries the list of audit policies
name: ListReviewRules

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host. 
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。 
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the paging query. Leave this parameter empty or do not specify it for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询开始的 Token。首次请求不传或者传空字符串
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of audit policies to return per request. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求获取最大审计规则个数，取值 1-100 整数。不传时默认取值 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The name of the audit policy to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的审计规则名称。模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to skip.

This parameter takes effect only when NextToken is empty
parameters.help_zh:
跳过数量。

仅在 NextToken 取值为空时生效
parameters.name: skip

MaxResults.description_en: The value of the MaxResults request parameter if a valid value was specified. Otherwise, the default value is returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 请求参数中传了有效MaxResults时返回请求时所传的值，否则返回默认值

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next request. Use this value for the NextToken request parameter in the next paging query. If this field is empty in the response, no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 下次请求Token，用于分页查询时下一次查询填写到请求参数NextToken中。若响应中该字段为空时，表示无更多数据

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Remark.description_en: The remarks of the audit policy

ScopeType.description_en:
The type of auditable asset scope specified in the audit policy. Valid values:

1: All projects.

2: Specified projects
ScopeType.description_zh:
审计规则中指定的可审计的资产范围规则类型。取值：

1：所有项目。

2：指定项目

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of audit policies returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的审计规则总数量
